top_signals.title: Zcash hits eight-year high near $850 with futures volume near $10 billion amid Grayscale ETF push
top_signals.summary: CoinGlass recorded nearly $10 billion in 24-hour futures volume and $1.76 billion in open interest, indicating that derivatives made up much of the trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
